summaries.software: Self-driven developer with B.Tech in Biotechnology, shipping 5 production web applications (FastAPI/Flask + Docker + GCP/Render). Built a full ML trading engine, A/B testing dashboard, and CRM — all with live deployments. Proficient in Python, SQL, and cloud infrastructure. Seeking SDE roles to build robust, scalable systems.
summaries.analytics: Analytical builder with a B.Tech in Biotechnology and hands-on experience deploying ML systems. Built a cost-aware trading engine (XGBoost, walk-forward validated) that turned a ₹225k drawdown into +₹93k profit, and an A/B testing dashboard using Bayesian methods. 38,500+ labeled trades. Seeking roles in analytics and decision science.
summaries.biotech: B.Tech Biotechnology student at NIT Rourkela bridging biology + data science. Developed ML models for peptide hydrogel prediction (ROC-AUC 0.888), deployed a Flask research portal, and built statistical trading systems. Comfortable in both biotech R&D and quantitative environments.
summaries.finance: Quant-leaning builder with B.Tech in Biotechnology. Designed an ML-filtered trading engine (XGBoost, walk-forward validated across 3 market windows) that improved performance from −₹225k to +₹93k. Deployed on GCP with PostgreSQL logging of 38,500+ trades. Strong in statistical modeling and cost-aware optimization.
summaries.freelance: Data science freelancer building deployed, production-grade ML web apps. Portfolio includes a statistical A/B testing dashboard, ML trading engine, CRM with analytics, and a biotech prediction portal. Delivering end-to-end from analysis to deployment on cloud (GCP/Render/Docker).
